items.description: , a family of frontier multilingual emebedding models that sets new state-of-the-art on at least 11 MTEB benchmarks. [code] [model & data]

items.description: , a family of state-of-the-art code embedding models in 0.5B and 7B sizes. C2LLM-7B ranks first on MTEB-Code leaderboard. [code] [model]

items.description: , a comprehensive code search benchmark covering two stages (retrieval, reranking), three tasks (text2code, code2text, code2code), and five languages. [data] [model & data]
